answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 20607 Country: India Title: 1. what to do for keeping PAAK when any islami news or Name of ALLAH published in news paper? 2. we have permission to deck with a wreth to picture of dead person? Question: 1. what to do for keeping PAAK when any islami news or Name of ALLAH published in news paper? 2. we have permission to deck with a wreth to picture of dead person? Answer ID: 20607 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 406/326/B=1431) (1) It is better if you and the thing on which you are writing are neat and clean. (2) No, it is unlawful to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
